research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Odys Aviation is focused on developing hybrid-electric VTOL aircraft for regional mobility. Their research includes multiple flight mode aircraft architectures and controls, featuring wings with actuating flaps that enable seamless transitions between forward cruise and vertical hover modes. This innovation supports the creation of versatile aircraft capable of efficient regional travel.

about_short_description.short_description: Odys Aviation is an aircraft startup making hybrid-electric vertical takeoff and landing (VTOL) aircraft for regional mobility.

product.name: Alta
product.description: A piloted hybrid-electric VTOL aircraft for regional passenger, cargo, medical, and defense transportation, with seating for up to nine passengers or cargo capacity up to 3,500 lb.

product.name: Laila
product.description: A hybrid-electric VTOL drone for defense, cargo, and logistics missions, offering runway-independent operation, a 450-mile range with a 130 lb payload, and multi-hour endurance.

product.name: Hybrid Propulsion Systems
product.description: Aviation-specific hybrid-electric propulsion systems spanning 30 kW to more than 1 MW for VTOL and other aircraft applications.

product.name: Autonomy and Mission Software Platform
product.description: A software stack for autonomous flight control, route planning, mission management, payload integration, and coordinated operation of commercial and defense aircraft.

product.name: Airborne Counter-UAS Solution
product.description: An airborne counter-drone capability using Laila as a long-range platform for detection, tracking, and defeat of unmanned aerial systems.
